input: Plan the following feature; do not write a patch. Identify implementation responsibilities, behavioral edge cases, and tests to add or inspect. Add a per-instance mutable Session.default_timeout attribute, initialized to None. Calls through Session.request/get/post and other existing method wrappers that OMIT timeout must use that attribute. An explicitly supplied timeout, including None, must win. Support the existing float and (connect, read) timeout shapes without adding validation rules. Redirects must keep the effective timeout. Preserve the direct Session.send contract; do not introduce global defaults or change Session constructor arguments. Document the distinction between omitted timeout and explicit None. This is an original exploratory feature, not an upstream issue.
